Senses.Explanation: The conventional count of the sage's sermon assemblies, named as one bulk corpus to be weighed against the one thing beyond words. Kaifu Daoning tells his assembly the sage came down from Tusita to Jambudvipa and spread boundless meanings through forty-nine years and three hundred-odd assemblies, matching sicknesses with prescriptions, Zhongfeng Mingben writes to the ailing monk Lin that those years and assemblies, dust-talk and world-talk now bound into one canon, are the prescription with the tasteless old case as its secret drug, Feiyin Tongrong weighs the same years and assemblies against the one upward move and calls them dust flung against the wind, beyond grasping, and Guting Shanjian rules that once the old case breaks open one suddenly sees them all as external business, with Shakyamuni's own face left homeless. Dabian Xianquan asks why, after declaring things beyond words, the old man threw dust for forty-nine years with three hundred-odd assemblies of tongue-boiling toil, Baichi Xingyuan rules that one taker that dawn would have spared the assemblies their long buying and short selling, principal and interest all lost at the last branch-tip, Wanru Tongwei has the star-struck sage come rushing out to preach those years and assemblies, prescribing true formulas and selling false medicine with nothing real in the lot until the final flower, and Jifei Ruyi praises the image with humans and gods bowing and fiends subdued, the three hundred-odd assemblies an echo answering an empty valley, the tail showing at the flower-and-smile.
